body: Create an animation-ready modular 2D cel shaded fantasy game cutout atlas, Arcane Vanguard style, bold clean dark outlines, painterly cel shading, detailed but readable at small size. Landscape high-resolution image on TRUE transparent alpha. SIX separate equally sized panels arranged THREE columns TWO rows. View directions reading order: E right profile, SE front-right threequarter, SW front-left threequarter, W left profile, NW rear-left threequarter, NE rear-right threequarter. Rear views show BACK of head/hair, BACK of clothing, no face or front chest ornament. Every panel contains exactly12 ISOLATED BODY PIECES in3columns4rows, consistent local ordering: row1 head, upper torso from neck to waist ONLY, rear cape; row2 pelvis/skirt, anatomical left upperarm, right upperarm; row3 left forearm including hand, right forearm including hand, left leg without foot; row4 right leg without foot, left boot, right boot. No full figures. Head entirely detached from torso. Arms split at elbows. Legs stop at ankles. NO equipment or effects in body sheet. Large transparent gutters between every cutout and everypanel. Avoid labels, checkerboard, background, panels, borders. Do not connect pieces. Full consistent identity across six genuine rotations. Subject: Inferno Witch queen, severe pale female face, black red hood with two upright curved black horns and a small gold brow ornament, long elegant black and deep crimson robes with gold V-shaped chest jewelry, ember orange accents, long black sleeves and dark boots. No permanently painted flames on body; fire effects separate. Style reference is only crisp2Dcel illustration with clearblackoutlines, not a clone of any existing character. Exactly72 disconnected pieces, nofusedheadtorso, noarmsattachedtorso. Keep the rear heads genuinely backfacing.
equipment: Equipment-only 2Dcel fantasy game cutout atlas true transparentalpha. SIX WANDS arranged3columns2rows, EVERY WAND VERTICAL perfectly upright frombottomhandle totopgem. Short black gold wand, orange gematTOP. All six sameverticalorientation, only objectrotation aroundverticalaxis different: Eprofile,SE,SW,Wprofile,NW,NE. No angledwand, no horizontalwand. No people/no hands/notext. Crispdarkoutlines,painterlycelshading, no background glow. Six separate props largeemptygutters.
effects: Transparent 2D hand-painted cel shaded fantasy GAME VFX SPRITESHEET. Exactly8columns4rows,32 individualanimationframes. Eachrow one8frame left-to-right animation. LARGE TRANSPARENTGUTTERS betweenframes androws. Allcells samesize, effectcentered, frame0 smallbeginning then development thenframe7 nearlyvanished. Absolutely no background haze rectangles, no whole-sheet mist, no text/grid, alphaoutsideindividualeffectsZERO. ArcaneVanguard crispcleanshapes subtlelimitedglow. ROW1: Demonic orange red hellfire projectile travelingright, narrow then broad then fades. ROW2: Hellfire burning target flame tongues grow, flare, then diminish; no character. ROW3: Small witch casting circle inred andgold builds thenfades. ROW4: Red orange summoning flames rise thenfades. No people.
